title: Rideout & Son warehouse fire May 19, 1988
description: On May 19, 1988, a fire in Hartland made headlines as far away as Bangor. When firefighters sifted through the debris, they discovered a coffin containing the 100-year-old skeleton of a middle-aged man. Nearby, they found robes inscribed with a skull and crossbones, a hangman’s noose, flags, swords, and dishes. Rumors quickly swept through the town, though investigators remained silent. Was it an unsolved murder or evidence of a secret cult in the quiet farming community? The fire chief reportedly ruled out arson and foul play. As it turned out, the once-active Knights of Pythias had used these items for their secretive initiation ceremonies and were sworn to secrecy. The skeleton was turned over to the RCMP, and the Rideout building was destroyed.
